calls.description: Routine call: hours question and a reservation

analysis.transcript_summary: Caller asked about Friday hours and booked a table for four.

transcript.message: Thank you for calling Olive & Ember. How can I help you today?
Hi, are you open this Friday night?
We are. On Fridays we're open from five until eleven.
Great. Can I book a table for four at seven thirty? It's my husband's birthday.
Happy to. Can I get a name and a phone number for the reservation?
Thank you, Helen. I've sent that request to the team and they'll confirm shortly.

calls.description: Unhappy guest: cold food and a long wait last night

body.issue_summary: Waited over an hour for mains last night; steak arrived cold and nobody checked on the table.

analysis.transcript_summary: Caller complained about a long wait and cold food on the previous night.

transcript.message: Thank you for calling Olive & Ember. How can I help you today?
I was in last night and honestly it was terrible. We waited over an hour for our food.
I'm so sorry. An hour is far too long to wait. Can you tell me what happened when the food came?
My steak was cold and nobody came to check on us. It's unacceptable for what you charge.
You're right, and I apologize. I'd like our manager to call you personally today. May I have your name and the best number to reach you?
Thank you, Robert. A manager will call you today at 512 555 0199. Thank you for telling us.

calls.description: Unhappy guest the live agent did NOT flag (post-call analysis must catch it)

analysis.transcript_summary: Caller was upset about a billing error and hung up.
